reviews.title: Best case I’ve owned
reviews.comment: Love this case! Great price, well made, great air flow. Fits my 5070ti comfortably. Looks awesome as well. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Tom F

reviews.title: Look's Great!
reviews.comment: Great case, easy to build in. Lacking in the 3.5" drive department, but the two included SSD slots behind the motherboard should prove adequate if you need to expand storage. The quality is as to be expected from Corsair, and the case itself is priced really reasonably for what you get.
reviews.author: Zaden

reviews.title: Love this case and recommend it
reviews.comment:
This case is by far my favorite PC case of all time, it has ample space inside for up to 9 case fans, a large CPU cooler, full sized GPU, among all the other things you may want to place inside. It can support up to an e-atx motherboard and has great cooling. It is a very sturdy case with no structural problems, and has a comfortable thickness that makes the case overall weighty but manageable. Additionally, the dust filters are nice and work well
I have seen no component compatibility issues an to close, the case is highly functional with no issues housing a high end computer build.
Absolutely love and recommend this case
reviews.author: Sirenz

reviews.title: Case to easily build in but with some qorks.
reviews.comment: Great case easily to build in. It does have limited space for SSDs. Can only mount two in the slot and cannot mount HHDs in the case even though it is labeled that you can.  Glass panels are held very well and buildings close to Lian Li cases if you’ve ever used those cases.  Corsair Shift PSU fit very well with plenty of room for cable management.  There are several tie points throughout the case but no secure straps. Would have been nice if it would have came with Velcro straps.  Case is of good weight and strength. Fan placement is ok.  Fan sizes are very strange.  120mm it is fine for but if mounting 140mm fans leaves a look that might be less desired.  Case would be a lot better if it came with rubber grommets for the cable routing holes.  Side panel only holds three 120mm or two 140mm which looks odd with 140mm. The ability to use 3 140mm fans would be a better look.  Size of case is perfect and hold quite a bit of items.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Beast of a Case
reviews.comment:
In love with this case. I probably spent more time selecting a case for my build than any other part, but man am I glad I picked this one. The wraparound glass panels are just sooo sleek, and the build itself is very high quality, though I am a sucker for corsair cases.
I got my aio 360 up top as exhaust, and the 3 intakes on the front side just look great. I even fit another fan on the bottom, right in front of the psu slot, and the cooling on this thing is amazing. It's heavy, but that's what you get from a beast of a case like this. Hiding all the fan cables was a bit of a puzzle, but manageable.
Overall, I'm stoked with this purchase. My pc looks friggin awesome.
reviews.author: jberna
